US President Donald Trump has praised India's economic growth, highlighting its 7% GDP growth rate and low interest rates. Criticising the Federal Reserve for keeping borrowing costs high, Trump said the US economy could grow faster with lower rates. He also highlighted new trade agreements with Asian nations and stronger Quad cooperation. Meanwhile, India and the US continue negotiations on a trade deal, with New Delhi seeking lower tariffs on its exports.
